kebab_example: aliyun agentloop create-pipeline --agent-space my-agent-space --pipeline-name my-pipeline --description '从_SLS_采集_Trace_数据清洗入_Dataset' --pipeline '{"nodes":[{"id":"node-1","type":"transform","parameters":{"key":"example-string"}}]}' --source '{"type":"SLS","logstore":{"query":"0_SELECT_0","project":"my-sls-project","logstore":"my-sls-logstore"}}' --sink '{"type":"Dataset","dataset":{"agentSpace":"my-agent-space","dataset":"my-dataset"}}' --execute-policy '{"mode":"RunOnce","scheduled":{"fromTime":1735660800000,"interval":"1h"},"runOnce":{"fromTime":1735660800,"toTime":1735747200}}' --client-token a1b2c3d4-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePipeline

parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace under which the pipeline is created
parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，流水线将创建在该 AgentSpace 下
parameters.name: agent_space

parameters.help_en: The pipeline name. The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
parameters.help_zh: 流水线名称，3~63 个字符，仅允许小写字母、数字和连字符
parameters.name: pipeline_name

parameters.example: 从 SLS 采集 Trace 数据清洗入 Dataset
parameters.help_en: The pipeline description. The description can be up to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 流水线描述，最长 256 个字符
parameters.name: description

element_fields.help_en: The node parameters in key-value format. The parameters vary depending on the node type
element_fields.help_zh: 节点参数，键值结构，随节点类型而定
element_fields.name: parameters

parameters.help_en: The pipeline configuration for node orchestration
parameters.name: pipeline

fields.help_en: The data source type. Currently, SLS is supported
fields.help_zh: 数据源类型，当前支持 SLS
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS project
fields.name: project

fields.help_en: The name of the SLS Logstore
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The data filtered query statement in SLS query/analysis syntax
fields.help_zh: 数据筛选查询语句（SLS 查询/分析语法）
fields.name: query

fields.help_en: The sink type. Currently, Dataset is supported
fields.help_zh: 目标类型，当前支持 Dataset
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace to which the destination dataset belongs
fields.help_zh: 目标数据集所属 AgentSpace 名称
fields.name: agent_space

fields.help_en: The name of the destination dataset
fields.name: dataset

parameters.help_zh: Pipeline 目标（数据写入目标）
parameters.name: sink

fields.help_en: The scheduling mode. Valid values: RunOnce (one-time execution) and Scheduled (periodic scheduling)
fields.help_zh: 调度模式：RunOnce（单次执行）或 Scheduled（周期调度）
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The start time of the data processing window, in Unix seconds. The value must be less than toTime
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口起始时间，Unix 秒，必须小于 toTime
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The end time of the data processing window, in Unix seconds. The value must be greater than fromTime
fields.help_zh: 数据处理窗口结束时间，Unix 秒，必须大于 fromTime
fields.name: to_time

fields.help_en: The one-time execution configuration. This parameter is required only when mode is set to RunOnce
fields.help_zh: 单次执行配置，仅 mode 为 RunOnce 时必填
fields.name: run_once

fields.help_en: The scheduling interval. Valid values: 1h, 6h, 12h, and 1d
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The scheduling start time, in Unix milliseconds
fields.help_zh: 调度起始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The periodic scheduling configuration. This parameter is required only when mode is set to Scheduled
fields.help_zh: 周期调度配置，仅 mode 为 Scheduled 时必填
fields.name: scheduled

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. A unique string generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the create operation
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token，客户端生成的唯一字符串，保证创建操作幂等
parameters.name: client_token

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the AgentSpace under which the pipeline is created
v1_parameters.help_zh: AgentSpace 名称，流水线将创建在该 AgentSpace 下
v1_parameters.name: agentSpace

v1_parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. A unique string generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the create operation
v1_parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token，客户端生成的唯一字符串，保证创建操作幂等
v1_parameters.name: clientToken
